title: palcheck file header still claims the gate scans house-body hexes after the W-B fold deleted them
detail: The W-B fold (commit message: "the header no longer overclaims bodies") fixed the const-block comment but the FILE header still lists house bodies among the scanned hexes; HOUSE_BODIES is deleted and no check scans it, so the file-header claim misleads.
recommended_fix: Drop "house bodies AND" from the file-header parenthetical so it matches the roofs-only checks (roof_names loop, HOST_ROOF, LED_GREEN, marking).

title: draw_bundles header (the N-B fold's edited block) retains two stale claims: the fiber-core draw and the exact single-member tier width
detail: No fiber-core draw exists post-7.1 (pipe_fiber survives only as the wide-tier band color in tier_pipe_color), and band_width scales even single-member bundles ×2.2 (narrow 3.5→7.7px), so both retained sentences contradict the code below the fold's hunk.
recommended_fix: Delete the fiber-core sentence (and the 'base pipe / fiber core' phrase at :225); restate the single-member line as "renders at band_width(tier,1) — 2.2x its tier wire width".

title: draw_packets comment still says at-node packets sit on the node; the 7.1 code piles them at the doorstep
detail: The comment block above draw_packets contradicts the at-node doorstep fan the code applies (pos.x += -0.80*s + kx; pos.y += 0.62*s + ky at :694-700); the N-A fold fixed the queued-on-edge sentence but left this adjacent one stale.
recommended_fix: Update the sentence to "at-node packets pile at the building's doorstep" to match the fan code below.
